text: With sincere devotion, I go for refuge in the Buddha.
With sincere devotion, I go for refuge in the Dharma.
With sincere devotion, I go for refuge in the Sangha.
I bow in repentance for being ignorant of where I came from and unmindful of where I am headed.
I bow in repentance for being ignorant of correct situation, relationship, and function.
I bow in repentance for having neglected my original nature.
I bow in repentance for having taken this body for granted.
I bow in repentance for having taken my ancestors for granted.
I bow in repentance for having taken my parents for granted.
I bow in repentance for having taken my relatives for granted.
I bow in repentance for being unmindful of all those who have contributed to my learning and education.
I bow in repentance for being unmindful of all those who have grown, prepared, and provided my nutrition.
I bow in repentance for being unmindful of all those who have made and provided my clothing.
I bow in repentance for being unmindful of all those who have built and provided my shelter.
I bow in repentance for manipulating people for my own selfish needs.
I bow in repentance for ignoring the effects of my misdeeds on others.
I bow in repentance to eradicate karma accumulated in the past, present, and future.
I bow in repentance to all those I have harmed through anger or rage.
I bow in repentance to all those I have harmed with words.
I bow in repentance to all those I have harmed through arrogance.
I bow in repentance to all those I have harmed through greed.
I bow in repentance to all those I have harmed through jealousy.
I bow in repentance to all those I have harmed through violence.
I bow in repentance to all those I have harmed through attachment to possessions.
I bow in repentance to all those I have harmed through attachment to likes-and-dislikes.
I bow in repentance to all those I have alienated through thought, word, and deed.
I bow in repentance to all those I have harmed through gossip, slander, and unmindful speech.
I bow in repentance to all those I have looked down upon.
I bow in repentance for my fearful thoughts, words, and deeds.
I bow in repentance for conceiving of this world through the lens of my ego.
I bow in repentance to all sentient beings that I have harmed or killed for entertainment and pleasure
I bow in repentance to those I have harmed through attachment to my thinking.
I bow in repentance to those I have harmed through foolish or unnecessary speech.
I bow in repentance to those I have harmed by engaging in relationships based on self-gratification.
I bow in repentance for harming other beings through unmindfulness, materialism and overconsumption.
I bow in repentance for my hypocritical thoughts, words and deeds.
I bow in repentance for all thoughts, words, and deeds that create attachment.
I bow in repentance for having believed that only what I saw was correct.
I bow in repentance for having believed that only what I heard was correct.
I bow in repentance for having believed that only what I smelled was correct.
I bow in repentance for having believed that only what I tasted was correct.
I bow in repentance for having believed that only what I touched was correct.
I bow in repentance for every action born from I-my-me mind.
I bow in repentance for not seeing clearly the interconnectedness of all life forms.
I bow in repentance for having disregarded the Earth-our only home.
I bow in repentance for unmindfully polluting the air.
I bow in repentance for unmindfully polluting the rivers, lakes and oceans.
I bow in repentance for unmindfully polluting the meadows, hills and mountains.
I bow in repentance for unmindfully destroying the plants and trees
I bow in repentance for a lifestyle built on the suffering of other forms of life
I bow in repentance for discriminating between the rich and poor in my choice of relations.
I bow in repentance for discriminating between high and low, the superior and the inferior.
I bow in repentance for discriminating between "good" and "bad."
I bow in repentance for seeing this world based on absolute "right" or "wrong."
I bow in repentance for my lack of compassion for the sick, injured or those trapped by addiction.
I bow in repentance for my lack of compassion for those suffering from depression, anxiety or mental illness.
I bow in repentance for my lack of compassion for the poor and impoverished.
I bow in repentance for my lack of compassion for those who are stubborn or difficult to work with.
I bow in repentance for my lack of compassion for the lonely or grieving.
I bow in repentance for my lack of compassion for those in trouble with the law.
I bow in gratitude for going for refuge in the Buddha.
I bow in gratitude for going for refuge in the Dharma.
I bow in gratitude for going for refuge in the Sangha.
I bow in gratitude for realizing that all beings are interconnected.
I bow in gratitude for realizing that all beings can communicate and sympathize with one another.
I bow in gratitude for realizing that all beings live in accordance with Universal Law.
I bow in gratitude for realizing that all beings have the same True Nature.
I bow in gratitude for realizing the wonders of all life forms.
I bow in gratitude for witnessing the beauty of this world.
I bow in gratitude for hearing the pure beauty of the birds' singing.
I bow in gratitude for hearing the spiritual sound of the wind.
I bow in gratitude for hearing the bubbling music of the streams.
I bow in gratitude for feeling the energy of the changing seasons.
I bow in gratitude for seeing the beauty of a shimmering rainbow.
I bow in gratitude for realizing that true peace of mind comes from being in harmony with Nature.
I bow in gratitude for realizing that Nature is Universal Law.
I bow in gratitude for realizing that Nature is our Great Teacher.
I bow in gratitude for realizing that compassion is the greatest blessing of all.
I bow in gratitude for realizing that a heart filled with hatred and resentment is the greatest misfortune of all.
I bow in gratitude for realizing that selfless love is the greatest power of all.
I vow to live in the embrace of the Buddha.
I vow to follow the teachings of the Dharma.
I vow to live in harmony with the Sangha.
I vow to be generous in all that I do.
I vow to act with a calm mind.
I vow to cultivate contentment.
I vow to speak only that which is kind, true and useful.
I vow to speak honestly.
I vow to only offer complements when speaking of others.
I vow to view others as equals.
I vow to do my best in all my endeavors.
I vow to be helpful in all that I do.
I vow to be humble in all that I do.
I vow to be honest in everything I do.
I vow to be positive in everything I do.
I vow to be loving toward others.
I vow to live with a compassionate heart.
I vow to cultivate a bright and patient heart.
I bow as a prayer so that all beings may live in peace.
I bow as a prayer for an end to all wars.
I bow as a prayer for an end to poverty.
I bow as a prayer for an end to all diseases.
I vow to practice the disciplines of the Bodhisattva.
I vow to cultivate spiritual wisdom.
I vow to be diligent in practice.
I vow to respect all of my teachers.
I vow to meet the Buddhas who appear in this world, from moment to moment.
I vow to transfer all merits accumulated through compassionate action to all beings throughout the ten directions.
